intro.h2: Quality that lasts long after the price is forgotten
paragraphs: DG Home Improvement LLC handles kitchen remodeling in Philadelphia for homeowners who want it done right the first time, or fixed after someone else got it wrong. One client hired Dennis and Kirill to correct issues left by previous contractors, then remodel her kitchen and several other rooms. She says her home finally feels complete.

The company is open about its approach: you might find someone who will do the job for less, but this crew will not cut corners to get there. Reviewers use the same words again and again: honest, detail-oriented, well organized. The work runs from white shaker kitchens with quartz counters to tub-to-shower bathrooms and new decks.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Philadelphia, plus baths and decks

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Full kitchen remodels with new cabinets, counters, backsplash and lighting. One recent kitchen has white shaker cabinets, white veined quartz, a white range hood, glass-front uppers, crystal pendant lights and a slate tile floor. Call Dennis to talk through your layout and finishes.

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Bathroom remodels, including taking out an old bathtub and installing a shower in its place. One family said even their neighbors were impressed with the design of the new bathroom. Bathroom remodels are one of the jobs clients mention most in DG's Google reviews.

about.h2: Meet Dennis and the DG crew
about.text: DG Home Improvement LLC is a Pennsylvania remodeling company led by Dennis, whose name and number are on the company's posts and in its reviews. Clients also name Kirill, who works alongside him on site. The crew handles kitchens, bathrooms, decks, balconies and demolition, and it has special offers for investors and construction companies. The company describes itself as fully insured and OSHA safety trained, and some of its recent finished projects were for returning customers. The company's posts all say the same thing: call Dennis, and you talk to him directly.

image.alt: DG Home Improvement crew member on a deck job site, with framing, post bases and the company's slogan

steps.title: Call Dennis
steps.text: Call (267) 423-2617 and talk directly with Dennis about your kitchen, bathroom, deck or the work another contractor left unfinished.

steps.title: Plan and drawings
steps.text: Dennis works out the plan with you, from drawings to materials, so you know what is being built before work begins.

steps.title: Demolition
steps.text: Every new project starts with demolition. The crew clears out the old room or deck quickly so the build can begin.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Dennis and his team build the new space with attention to detail and handle challenges as they come up.

steps.title: Clean-up and final inspection
steps.text: The crew cleans up the property before the final inspection, so you are left with a finished space, not a job site.

items.name: Victoria K.
items.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Outstanding experience from start to finish with DG Home Improvement. Dennis and Kirill did an amazing job correcting issues left by previous contractors and transforming our kitchen and several other rooms. They were professional, reliable, detail-oriented, and genuinely cared about the quality of their work.

What I appreciated most was their honesty and commitment to getting everything done right rather than taking shortcuts. The final result exceeded my expectations, and my home finally feels complete.

Highly recommend this company to anyone looking for quality craftsmanship and trustworthy professionals. Thank you, Dennis and Kirill!

items.name: Vadim P.
items.text: We used DG Home Improvement for remodeling our bathroom by installing the shower in place of the old bathtub. The team made outstanding job. We are highly impressed with their professionalism and the quality of our new bathroom. Our neighbors were also impressed by design of our remodeled bathroom. Great quality, great team to work with. Thank you!

items.name: Kirill
items.text:
We had a great experience working with Denis and his team on our balcony and deck project. From the very beginning, they demonstrated a highly professional approach in every aspect of the work. The project started with a quick and efficient demolition, and throughout the process the team handled several challenges with professionalism and clear expertise.

What stood out most was their attention to detail and commitment to doing the job correctly without cutting corners. Communication was clear, the work was well organized, and the quality of craftsmanship was evident at every stage of the project.

The final result truly speaks for itself — the balcony and deck turned out beautifully and exceeded our expectations. We are extremely pleased with the outcome and would highly recommend Dennis and his team to anyone looking for a contractor who takes pride in their work and delivers high-quality results with a professional approach.

service_area.h2: Serving homeowners in the Philadelphia area
service_area.text: DG Home Improvement LLC is a Pennsylvania company with a Philadelphia-area phone number. It works at your home on kitchens, bathrooms, decks and balconies. The quickest way to check whether your street is in range is to call Dennis at (267) 423-2617 with your neighborhood or town and a short description of the job. Deck season fills up, so ask about open dates when you call.

items.q: Can you fix work another contractor left behind?
items.a: Yes. One client hired DG Home Improvement to correct issues left by previous contractors, then remodel her kitchen and several other rooms. She praised the crew's honesty and commitment to getting everything right rather than taking shortcuts. Call Dennis and describe what was left unfinished.

items.q: Can you turn my bathtub into a walk-in shower?
items.a: Yes. One family had DG Home Improvement remove their old bathtub and install a shower in its place. They were highly impressed with the quality, and their neighbors liked the design too. Call Dennis at (267) 423-2617 to talk through the size and layout of your bathroom.

DG Home Improvement LLC states that it is fully insured and that its team is OSHA safety trained. Ask Dennis for the insurance certificate when you get your quote, so you have it on file before work starts on your kitchen, bathroom or deck.

items.q: Should my deck be pressure-treated wood or composite?
items.a: Dennis posts about the choice between pressure-treated wood and composite, and he can walk you through both. Call (267) 423-2617 to talk about your deck or balcony and how you plan to use it, and ask about sealing an existing deck before the outdoor season.

items.q: Do you work with investors or builders?
items.a: Yes. DG Home Improvement has special offers for investors and construction companies, and some of its recent finished projects were for returning customers. Call Dennis at (267) 423-2617 for details on the kind of work you have and what the offer includes for your project.

final_cta.text: Call Dennis to talk through your kitchen, bathroom or deck.
